text:
Predicates:
AllowedPetsInManaged(x) ::: Pets are allowed in managed building x.
DepositRequired(x) ::: A deposit is required to rent apartment in building x.
DepositAtLeast(x, y) ::: The security deposit at building x is at least y.
DepositEqual(x, y) ::: The security deposit at building x is equal to y.
Pet(x, y) ::: x is a pet of y.
Cats(y) ::: y are cats.
ManagedBuilding(x) ::: x is a managed building.
Rent(x, y) ::: The monthly rent at building x is y.
MoreThan(x, y) ::: x is more than y.
RentInManaged(x, y) ::: x will rent an apartment in building y.
AllowedToMoveInWith(x, y) ::: x is allowed to move in with pet y.
SecurityDeposit(x) ::: The security deposit at building x.
NoMoreThan(x, y) ::: x is no more than y.
AllowsPets(x) ::: x allows pets.
InBuilding(x, y) ::: x can move into building y with pet y.

Premises:
Pets are allowed in some managed buildings ::: ∃x (AllowedPetsInManaged(x))
A deposit is required to rent an apartment in a managed building ::: ∀x (ManagedBuilding(x) → DepositRequired(x))
The security deposit can be either equal to the monthly rent at a managed building or more ::: ∀x (ManagedBuilding(x) → (DepositEqual(x, Rent(x)) ∨ DepositAtLeast(x, Rent(x))))
Fluffy is Tom's cat ::: Pet(Fluffy, Tom)
Cats are pets ::: ∀x (Cats(x) → Pet(x, _))
The Olive Garden is a managed building ::: ManagedBuilding(oliveGarden)
The monthly rent at the Olive Garden is $2000 ::: Rent(oliveGarden, 2000)
$2000 is more than $1500 ::: MoreThan(2000, 1500)
Tom will rent an apartment in a managed building if he is allowed to move in with Fluffy, and the security deposit is no more than $1500 ::: ∀x (RentInManaged(x, y) → (AllowedToMoveInWith(Tom, Fluffy) ∧ NoMoreThan(SecurityDeposit(y), 1500)))

Conclusion:
If a managed building allows pets, then people are allowed to move in with a pet ::: ∀x (AllowsPets(x) → ∀y (Pet(y, _)) → AllowedToMoveInWith(_, y))
